cam-model-cleanup.desc: Daily registry retention (cam-model-tasks.ts cleanupExpired). /fail carries the failed-deletion count or abort reason.

cam-model-activity-backfill.desc: One-shot lemoncams history import; done-state ticks still ping. Delete this check when the cron is retired (#65).

cam-roster-sync.desc: Roster sync heartbeat (POST /api/cam-models/sync, ~every 5 min; 10m period + 10m grace = deliberate margin). /fail = provider feeds degraded; silence = the sync chain is broken.
